items.context: i gott save for it anyways (im working on saving for a new ipad rn so i can keep doing commissions and art) so i have time to think about it/wait for a sale to come along but its a lot of money to drop on a game ya know
items.text: Waiting makes sense when it's a big price. Wishlist it on the store so you get a heads-up when it goes on sale, and check its price history to see what a real low looks like.
